0022600214.text: The Heat (4-6) come in as the 11th-game road team after winning their last game, sitting 8th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, with a 3-3 road record. The Jazz (1-9) have lost eight straight and are 15th in the West, with Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic out because of a knee injury and a foot strain, and Keyonte George and Lauri Markkanen listed as day-to-day with ankle and wrist sprain injuries and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 115-111 Utah win in Miami on February 9, 2026.
